meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: Claude会模拟多个AI智能体开会：按你定的主题和目标配置角色，依次发言、辩论、总结，最后给出含决策结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你需要从多个角度分析问题、让不同领域知识碰撞，或想模拟团队决策讨论时触发。

say.text: 请模拟会议，讨论我们是否该采用微服务架构。
say.note: Claude会配置技术架构师等角色并组织讨论。

say.text: 安排一个新产品定价策略会议，请产品经理、财务顾问参加。
say.note: 按角色分派发言并输出定价建议。

say.text: 开个项目风险评估会，查一查潜在风险。
say.note: 生成风险清单和应对措施。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will simulate a multi-agent meeting: it configures roles based on your topic, runs discussion stages, and outputs a meeting record with decisions, key arguments, risks, and actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need multi-angle analysis, cross-domain expertise, or a simulated team decision discussion.

say_en.text: Simulate a meeting to discuss whether we should adopt microservices.
say_en.note: Claude will set roles like tech architect and moderate.

say_en.text: Arrange a pricing strategy meeting with PM and finance advisor.
say_en.note: Assigns speaking turns and gives pricing proposals.

say_en.text: Run a project risk assessment meeting.
say_en.note: Produces risk list and mitigation actions.
